balls.text: Arora misses the chance to run Archer out at his end... but Archer is eventually run out at the keeper's end. A comical end to the innings. The third umpire confirms that Archer is miles short of his crease. Arora bowled a bouncer, and got the ball to finish over middle stump as the ball climbed nicely. Archer went to scoop but missed, and pushed for a bye. Seifert threw it to Arora, who couldn't collect the throw cleanly. So in trying to capitalise on the miss, Archer and Brijesh went for the second but Archer fell way short

wide of the man at fine leg this time. Tyagi there moved and ran to his left, but the ball went below him. Short ball with a scrambled seam on leg, and Archer pulled it from close to his left shoulder
on a length, and outside leg. Brijesh moves around in the crease, and pulls to fine leg
short in length, and outside off. Brijesh goes for the pull but completely misses the ball, which goes over his bat
excellent bowling. Arora swings this in and fires a yorker at 139kph on middle. Archer jams his bat down, and gets the ball to roll to fine leg
Green cuts it off to his left from deep midwicket. Short delivery around off from Arora, and Archer pulled it flat and wide of long-on
a low full toss just outside off, and pushed forward towards cover. Tyagi has his hands on his head - maybe he wanted to bowl that one better - but still finishes with career-best figures of 3 for 22

third wicket in the over!! Bishnoi gets an outside edge to the keeper, as Seifert moves to his right to take the ball close to his chest. This very full ball from Tyagi swings away to land at a near yorker length just outside off. Bishnoi goes low to slice, but gets an outside edge
short of a length, and wide of off. Bishnoi looks to slash, but is beaten by the pace and bounce

got him!! A full toss, but Tyagi gets his man. Seam up from Tyagi, who bowled a full toss at Hetmyer's knee at 142kph. Hetmyer went for a swipe, but seemed to have played too early. The ball took the leading edge, and ballooned for deep third, where Raghuvanshi moved forward to grab the ball
slams the stumps at the bowler's end, and the ball deflects to long-on - imagine how forcefully that was hit! Full ball around off, and he drove back aerially
wide outside off. Archer has a slash at this short-of-a-length ball wide of off, and misses

got him!! Green is manning the fine-leg boundary, and he completes the catch by tumbling to his left. Tyagi bowls a slower one to begin, and one that is short in length. The ball climbs up nicely even as it's bowled with a scrambled seam. Jadeja pulls it behind square, but it isn't hit all that powerfully
yorker length, and wide of off. Jadeja slashes to deep third

dropped by Arora!! He was at backward square leg, and moved back while keeping his eyes on the ball. It arrived to his right, and he spilled the chance, after Hetmyer pulled a short and rising ball from just outside off, and got a top edge
on the bounce to deep midwicket. In fact, both Raman and Seifert aren't very pleased that Anukul couldn't take the catch. Short ball outside off from Raman, and Jadeja swat-pulled it
and again. Raman looks to keep it away from Jadeja's reach, but ends up conceding a wide. Very full and wide of off, and left alone
wide outside off. Jadeja still looks to throw his bat at this yorker-length ball angling across to arrive around ninth stump
shapes for the sweep again... but ends up pulling for four. Lack of pace, and short on the stumps. Jadeja is slightly across the stumps, and dumps the ball over square leg for four

Ah, I've seen Jadeja sweep against pace before, and this one probably comes after really long. He picks this length ball from wide of off, and places it to deep square leg before completing two quickly
starts with a slower ball which is short. It pitches on middle, and finishes wide of off. Pulled to deep square leg
good bowling. Another yorker-length ball. This lands on middle, and is flicked to deep midwicket

superb stop by Green!! He prevents a boundary with his long reach there. Placed at deep-backward square leg, he runs and throws himself to his right to keep it to two. Hetmyer had swiped at this dipping full toss on off
too high, and wide. Arora bowls short with a scrambled seam around seventh stump, and Hetmyer lets it go
short in length again, and this rises towards Jadeja's waist on off. Dabbed to point for a hurried single
extra bounce for Arora. He bowls this on a short of a length, and wide of off. Jadeja looks to slash by reaching out, but misses
follows it up with an inswinging attempted yorker. It ends up being a low full toss on middle, and Hetmyer clips to fine leg
starts with a bouncer at just 129kph outside off. Hetmyer pulls aerially towards deep midwicket

caught and bowled!! Narine has Ferreira after beating him all over. Ferreira looked to half push at it from leg stump, and ended up getting a leading edge back to Narine. On a length, and finishing on leg, but Ferreira plays his shot early. The pitch is quite slow, remember, so getting a leading edge isn't entirely unexpected
fuller side again, and on off. The ball straightens, and is jabbed back
huge six!! Not only does Ferreira finally connect but he also gets the maximum. This slower ball dips on a fullish length just outside off, and Ferreira heaves to go over midwicket
fullish on middle, and turning in. Hits Ferreira's inside edge as he looks to push forward
again!! Almost a carbon copy of the last ball. Just that there's extra bounce off a length just outside off. Ferreira again goes for the drive, but is beaten on the outside edge
beaten!! He fires this full and quick, and just outside off. The ball doesn't turn, and Ferreira looks to drive but the ball goes past the outside edge
full and on off, and quicker at 97kph. Blocked back to end Varun's spell at 3 for 14
on a length on off, and driven to deep midwicket off the inside half of the bat

bowled him!! A bit of cat-and-mouse stuff over these last three balls. Varun is pumped up - how rare of that to happen. He bowls a googly on a short of a length just outside off or thereabouts, and the ball turned in. Parag went for a big heave across the line, but missed. The ball hit the off stump, and sent Eden and Varun into screaming delight
one-bounce four. Parag responds with the reverse sweep at this full ball around off, and goes over short third

a little thought from Varun and Seifert for a potential lbw... but it's not given. KKR review, though. There's no bat involved as Parag looks to pull, but the ball goes below his bat. It was short in length, and just outside off. The ball turned in considerably, and ball tracking shows impact as umpire's call on leg, with the ball missing the stumps
full and just outside off. He looks to drive, but gets the bottom edge to the keeper's right
a fumble from Powell, as he moved to his left from long-on... and the ball nearly touched the boundary cushion. It was a full toss on off, and Hetmyer swung across the line

ohh, Hetmyer looked to leave that short ball, but ended up getting a bottom edge on the bounce to the keeper. Slower ball again from Tyagi, who goes for the bouncer on middle. The ball shapes away, and Hetmyer shaped to sway out of the way
slower short ball from Tyagi. He bowls a cutter on off, and Parag rolls his wrists to pull late to deep square leg
Short of a length, and wide of off. Pushed to extra cover
a length delivery outside leg, and Tyagi gets away with this. Hetmyer goes for the swipe, but the ball hits his leg and trickles to short fine leg for a leg bye
shot of a length on middle and leg at 144kph. Pushed to mid-off

Hetmyer wants two, but Parag sends him back. He nudges this length ball turning away to finish on middle and leg, and the ball dribbled towards deep square leg. Rinku was quick to throw it back, and that stopped the chance of a second
short in length, and a little wide of off. Turns away, and Parag cuts hard to deep point
on a length, and just outside off. Hetmyer shifts his weight back to swipe it to long-on
full and on off. There's no turn for Varun, and Hetmyer goes back to to block
full and slow, and just outside off. There's a hint of turn back in, and Parag clips it to deep midwicket by playing with the turn
a full ball in the channel just outside off, and slashed to deep point
shorter side of a length, and outside off. This one turns away from Parag, who punches it wide of long-off for two
ohh, this fullish ball straightens from just outside off, and is cut away to deep cover
on a length, and around sixth stump. It turns in, and is punched to long-on
on a length on off, and cut away to deep-backward point after letting the ball turn away

well taken by Rahane!! He slides to his right from extra cover, and grabs this forceful slash from Jaiswal. Narine dangled it up and went really slow, angling across and bowling full and around seventh stump. Jaiswal leaned into the loft while playing away from himself, and ended up playing aerially.
goes quite full and slow on off. Driven towards deep point
short of a length, and just outside off. Punched down to long-on after letting it turn back in
shorter side of a length, and finishing on middle after pitching outside off. Dabbed down
blocks this full ball turning into him

caught? or stumped? Either way, Seifert thinks he has Jurel. Yup, it's confirmed that Jurel is stumped. His back leg is clearly short when Seifert has whipped the bails off. Jurel looked to reverse sweep this full delivery wide-ish of off, but lost his balance and missed. Seifert was quick enough to clip the bails, and find his fellow keeper short
slog sweeps, but the ball is much slower. Varun goes full on middle and leg, and the ball turns away. Single to deep square leg
full ball dipping around sixth stump, and turning in. A quick push to cover from Jurel
pace off again, shorter now and he turns it to leg for a single
pace off and full again, it'a a low and dipping full toss driven down to long off
slow and short cutter again well outside off, left alone for a wide

scooped for six! Fine leg was in, the run rate had started to drop and Jaiswal takes the innovative route. Goes down to nearly kiss the pitch so he can connect with the ball well and middles that one right behind the keeper. Great connection
goes for a wide yorker perhaps and it's too wide, sixth of the innings
another slower one, slightly full outside off and driven down for one

124kmh, cutting in and he helps it along behind square on the leg side where Tyagi slides near the rope and his foot might have touched the rope while keeping the ball in. They're checking for that...looked like his foot had touched the rope but the umpire says it's clean, so only two
starts with a slow bouncer at 114.3kmh, Jaiswal tries to get over it and hooks it for one
96.4kmh, again turning in without much room to work with and he works it to midwicket
turning in first ball, no room at all, and he blocks

Varun breaks the opening wicket and he's sent back Vaibhav Sooryavanshi! The teenager went big on the leg side, trying to clear midwicket but he skied that into the blue sky and Ramandeep did very well to run in from the deep, keep his eyes on it throughout and he might have misjudged it a little, but his dive made up for it in the end. Bishop says on commentary that was hit towards the longer boundary
big appeal but not massive as Jaiswal misses his reverse and is hit on his gargantuan pad, but maybe outside leg. They get a leg bye though, no review taken
93.7kmh, slightly slower and goes across again, he pokes and misses
98.1kmh, on middle and leg and going across with the angle, and he's tucked to leg for one
drills the full ball through the covers along the ground, and Rinku cuts it off for two
bangs the slow offcutter into the pitch, Jaiswal slams it away for one through covers
goes for another slower one but that's a full toss and it's hit towards wide long on, where Powell does well to keep it inside with a dive

falls just short! Rinku Singh hares in from deep cover as Sooryavanshi has miscued the big hit off the offcutter from Tyagi, but the ball just beats him by landing in front of him and then goes under him for four
goes for middle stump line now, he pushes it down the ground for one
beats him first ball with one at 140kmh. Was full and outside off, he drives and misses
99.6kmh, turning into the batter from leg and he is cramped for room. Ends up defending it back
some width on the off side and he gets one on off with an inside edge
better ball from Narine. Short, flat and some turn towards leg, but it's tucked away for two more
gets room on the off side and he reaches out for it and sends that crashing all along the ground as it's a half volley. Four runs
turning towards leg from leg stump, Jaiswal doesn't read that one and gets hit on the pad
gets a length ball towards leg and he works it to leg for one
finally he gets it right, manages to keep it inside the line and makes Jaiswal miss the big swing down the ground. Dot ball
this over ain't ending. Short of length and he tries to keep it outside his hitting arc, sends down another wide
he gets in position for a scoop, but Green has pitched it wide towards the off line and Jaiswal adjusts in a flash to lap it on the other side over short third! Excellent execution
short outside off, cut fiercely towards point and it falls well short. They sneak in a quick single as it goes off Vaibhav Arora and results in almost an overthrow eventually
Green is in the red zone, bangs in a short of length ball outside off and it's another wide
goes for a wide yorker with the angle now and another wide
Sooryavanshi's engine is up and running! Gets a full delivery and he smashes that right over Green's head, just goes all the way, the umpires have checked
goes for the wide yorker again and gets it right this time, Jaiswal bunts it out to short third and that was some lazy running from Sooryavanshi!! He would have been out had that been a direct hit
he brings deep point in but bowls this one wide outside off. Called a wide
there comes a six from Jaiswal too! Green goes short with a cutter and Jaiswal dispatches that over wide long-on with a big swing
clears his front foot for the ball turning away to off and cuts it again, finds point again
looks a bit slower on length outside off, he pushes it back
shorter outside off and he cuts it straight to point
outside off now and turning away, he swings big again but misses this time
smoked for the first six of the day! Sooryavanshi continues the trend of smashing legendary bowlers early on. Pitched up around middle and leg and he sent it crashing over midwicket
offbreak first ball and he is beaten. Going by Green's reaction at slip, it might have been an edge
ends the over on middle stump and Sooryavanshi gets a single to off
he goes even shorter and here Sooryavanshi ramps that while staying very still, just moves his arms towards the ball to send it flying for a one-bounce four. The third of the over
another cut on the off side, this time from Jaiswal and Anukul Roy does very well to dive to his right and stop it with one hand
goes from off to leg and shorter towards the ribs, he gets a single on leg
nearly hands a catch to point! But falls short. He cuts this one on the up, it's dipping towards the backward point fielder and as he dives, the ball bounces in front of him and goes away for four
too short and outside off and Sooryavanshi crashes that square for a cracking boundary! The connection was so good he didn't have to move his feet much
fullish outside off and driven straight to cover!
nearly chops on! This one swings in late and Jaiswal drives but only manages an inside edge onto his pad
rolls his fingers over that for an offcutter outside off, Jaiswal mistimes it back
134.6kmh, almost a yorker as that's full and swinging in, Jaiswal flicks it away but he's sent back by his partner
ramped for a one-bounce four! Green goes even shorter to Jaiswal, and he hangs back to ramp it almost all the way. Good use of the pace of the ball
cramps him for room by going short outside off and Sooryavanshi gets a single to point
146.8kmh, on the pads again and Sooryavanshi clips it away for one
140.1kmh, a bit of pace off, pretty straight on leg and Sooryavanshi mistimes the defence back to the bowler
more on leg this time and it's tucked to midwicket
the slip goes off and Sooryavanshi gets a four right through the slip region! Swinging away from good length, and that probably looked intentional from Sooryavanshi to help it fine on the off side
146.4kmh, bangs it in short now and Sooryavanshi goes back to defend in front of his chest
144.8kmh, good pace to begin with but it's too full and too much on leg and it's flicked away rather easily for four
tighter line and more swing from outside leg towards middle, Jaiswal carefully watches and blocks
128.1kmh, outswing again outside off, Jaiswal waits before dabbing it to short third
touch shorter and he crashes it through the off side! First boundary of the day. Jaiswal spotted the shorter length early, stayed on the back foot and cut it square right off the middle
through him! Excellent ball swinging towards middle and leg and moves a bit further to go just over off stump as Jaiswal drives and misses
the line is a tad lighter and Sooryavanshi also defends on the off side for a quick single
starts with his usual outswing for left-handers outside off, short of length and Jaiswal taps it to off to get off the mark

top edge, six, Rinku's fifty, and KKR's first win this season!! Eden turns purple with a million KKR flags fluttering in the air. It was a short delivery from Brijesh, and Rinku went for the pull. But the ball ballooned off the top edge, and went over Jurel to land just beyond the boundary. The seventh-wicket pair of Rinku and Anukul takes KKR to their first win in seven attempts
Rinku has a heave but is hit on his pad outside leg. The impact is outside leg, and the ball trickles down on the pitch. Anukul wants the run, but is sent back
four more!! Rinku clatters this over extra cover. Lack of pace, and full and just outside off. Rinku reads it, and slashes it late with confidence in his eyes
pulled wide of short fine leg. Rinku brings it down to 5 needed off 5. Short of a length, and slow just outside leg. Rinku places it to the right of the man inside the circle
low full toss on off, and lofted unconvincingly towards mid-off. The man from long-off chases it forward, but can't prevent two
nicely bowled. Another yorker on off, and Rinku is nearly squared up as he drives it off the outside half of the bat to deep-backward point
darted in as a yorker just outside off. Anukul drills it to deep-backward point

bam!! A short-arm loft over long-off. Archer keeps testing the batters with the yorker length, but barely misses this time. Anukul is deep in the crease, and launches it back powerfully from around off stump
yorker length, and just outside off. Flung away to long-on. Only a single again
good ball... and well fielded by Parag. The ball is very full at 149kph on leg, and driven to Parag's left at mid-off. The RR captain does well to move and tumble, before cutting this off
quite full on leg, and driven down to long-off
some luck goes KKR's way. Short in length on leg, and he looks to swat-pull after backing away. But he gets a bottom edge on to his back thigh, and the ball beats Jurel to his left
Rinku decides to move around this time. He backs away, and gets what is a low full toss way outside leg. Swept to deep square leg
another one down the leg side. Rinku goes pulling at the short ball, and ends up hitting it on the bounce to Jurel
this is surely a wide, and it's given so. Short ball at a lack of pace on middle, and the ball shaped away to finish wide of off. Rinku let it go
Rinku looks to review... but they have none of it. Brijesh bowls on a length and just outside leg again. Rinku went swiping but was beaten
ahh, KKR have run out of reviews, although this seemed wide and was not given. Short in length, and outside leg. Rinku looked to clip but missed, and the ball touched nothing

too high, but it's not called wide. So KKR review. Archer bowled a short ball which rose up sharply in and around off stump. The first replay indicates the ball may have just gone over Anukul's head as he looked to ramp. Oh, that's just 0.02 metres below his head height. So it's a fair ball in the end
a knee-height full toss on off, and pushed down to long-on
great bowling. Archer launches an inswinging yorker on middle, and Anukul can only clips it off his toes to deep midwicket
fuller side of a length around sixth stump, and he opens the face of the bat to guide it to deep third
goes wide of mid-off. Who said Rinku was out of form?? He's deep in the crease, and lofts this length delivery just outside off. Archer went on the hittable length, and Rinku found the right area
wide down the leg side. KKR surely have the momentum. Archer angles it in, and lands this as a yorker outside leg. Rinku looks to whip but misses
four over short fine leg. Rinku is across and deep in the crease, and picks this short ball rising towards his throat to pull for four
Shot!! Eden roars at that. Anukul sends the ball flaying over extra cover. Bishnoi tosses one up, and goes full and wide-ish of off. Anukul lofts through the line, and launches at the ball
this is quicker from Bishnoi. Full ball on leg, and the wrong one. Rinku goes back to whip to deep square leg
full and wide of off. Anukul reaches out and drives to deep point
wide again. Very full and outside leg. Anukul looks to flick but misses
length ball wide of off, and turns away. Anukul slashes hard to deep extra cover, where Hetmyer runs and dives to his left to save three runs
short ball outside leg at 104kph. Rinku goes for the pull, but is hit on his body. Jurel is hit as well and the ball dribbles towards the off side
on a length, and outside leg. It straightens as Rinku lets it go. Wide ball
bashed over deep square leg. Rinku nails this slog sweep off this full ball on middle, as he clears his front leg and goes bang!

Ferreira does well to move forward from long-off, but the ball falls just short. He throws it to Parag, who aims at the stumps but concedes an overthrow. Anukul had lofted this fullish ball outside off, but couldn't time or place it well
full and straight, and slower too. Pushed off the inside half of the bat to short fine leg
down the pitch, and four. Full ball just outside off, and Rinku played this from leg stump before going over Parag's head
Jurel appeals excitedly for a caught-down-the-leg-side chance, but it's called wide instead. Full and outside leg, and Rinku missed as he looked to sweep
tossed up, and very full on middle and off. Driven to long-off
full ball, and slower on middle. The ball straightens, and is pushed to the leg side
very full on leg, and swept towards short fine leg
now finds point. Anukul goes to slash at this length ball on the stumps, and is cramped for room in looking to cut
on a length on off, and turning away. Slashed to short third's left
half an appeal for lbw, but that was heading down. A slow legspinner turning into leg, as Anukul looked to flick but was hit on the pad

chopped on!! Punja is off the mark in IPL. Raman is down on his haunches. Punja tosses it up, and bowls full and wide of off. The ball dips on to Raman, who goes slashing at it by reaching out. But he's beaten by the flight and lack of pace, and ends up getting a bottom edge before the ball drops and hits the middle stump
full and dipping on off. Blocked down
full and slow on middle and leg. Pushed to long-on
full and slow, and turning away from off. Rinku jabs to point, and they push for a rapid single
this full ball keeps a little low on the stumps. Raman goes back and dabs towards square leg. Jurel chases and throws at the bowler's end, but wide of the stumps
similar line and length, only that this one is much slower. It dips on a sixth-stump line, and turns in. Driven back by Raman
drilled through extra cover. Bishnoi fired it at 103kph, and Raman drove it back quicker. Full and flat, and wide of off, as he reached out and crashed it
full and straight, and driven to long-on
on a length on off, and turning in. He goes back to clip behind square
short of a length, and slightly wide of off. Cut away to deep-backward point
lovely ball!! Flighted, full, and dipping around sixth stump. It turns away as Raman looks to drive, but misses. The ball beats the outside edge
fuller and outside off again. This hints to turn in, and is tapped down
good ball. On a full length outside off, and the ball straightens. Raman looks to block but is squared up, and misses
short in length, and outside leg. It's the wrong one, as it turns away to finish on middle. Pulled to deep midwicket, from where the fielder rushes forward to try and take it on the bounce
short and wide-ish of off. Slapped to deep cover

ohhh, Burger drops the biggest sitter of them all!! Jurel is stunned. Sandeep Sharma, in the dugout, can hardly believe what he has seen. Rinku went for the no-look slog across the line off this fullish ball outside off, but got a top edge. The ball flew up, only for Burger to move forward from short third, and settle under it. Jurel was moving towards him, but stopped well short. Burger, though, ended up spilling it
beaten!! This also keeps a little low off a length. This is around seventh stump, and Rinku went to cut
on a length, and just outside off. Swiped to deep midwicket
like Raghuvanshi, Rinku attempts a reverse sweep. This ball is on the shorter side of a length outside off, and turns in. Rinku gets an inside edge to short third
full and slow again, but this is around sixth stump. Driven to long-off

ohh, Powell falls!! He attempts to slog Jadeja down the ground, but this ball is a bit tossed up, and much slower as well, as it dips on a length on the stumps. Powell looks to swing but hits it to Ferreira at long-on to break what seemed like a steady stand
looked like a wrong'un towards middle and leg, works it with the turn behind square on leg for one more
loopy push back towards the bowler a bit but far towards his left, single for Rinku
tighter line, not full either, and Powell is forced to dab it square for a single
some room and Powell slams that cover drive straight to cover
flat and quick wide down the leg side
on the pads and flicked away for one easily
he cuts the ball from just outside off and Hetmyer does well in the deep behind square to dive and keep it to two
quick and tight line and length, pushed into the covers but no run this time
over the wicket and wide of the crease, he drives it away in the gap for one
he comes down, Jadeja replies with a quick one and he turns it to leg for one
93.3kmh, leans into the quick ball and ends up defending just in time
95.6kmh, flattish on middle and leg, Rinku whips it away square on the leg side for one
91.2kmh, full on the pads and worked to leg for one
straightish leg break on leg, nudged to leg for one more
94.2kmh, quick and going towards leg, Powell doesn't quite adjust to the pace but manages some bat on it fine on the leg side for four
starts on the pads and he flicks for one, off the mark
tight line again, leans into the ball to tap it into the covers for a quick single. Direct hit from Jadeja at the bowler's end but Powell has made it
96kmh, Powell rocks back to cut again for the slightly wider line, beaten again
beauty from Yash Raj! Ripping leg break that pitches outside off, pushes Powell on the back foot and nearly takes the edge with a hint of turn

loud appeal for lbw as Raghuvanshi misses the reverse and the umpire raises the finger! Jadeja does have a wicket in his first over although Raghuvanshi reluctantly takes the review. Ball-tracking has not even loaded and he's started walking. No edge, pitches on off, hits him on off and that's hitting top of middle. So KKR lose a review
stays back this time, let's the ball turn a bit and cuts to point
comes down the track and punches that into the covers
misses the sweep as he tries to reach for that from way outside off
angling in and he stays back to work it to leg for one
almost gets a wicket first ball! Powell miscues the defence and hands a return catch, Jadeja dives forward and goes leaping but the ball lands just in front of him
87.1kmh, gets the toe end of the bat while trying to flat-bat it back, single to long off
outside off with some turn and bounce, he rides the bounce and punches to cover
full toss and dispatched on the other side now all the way! It's a juicy full toss with generous flight and Powell smashes it away into the crowd
gives width to Powell who frees his arms and clears the in-field with some power. May not have middled it but got enough for a four
92kmh, loopy legbreak towards the feet, clipped down to long on for one
decent flight to start with outside off, pushed into the off side
tries to fox Bishnoi by making room and then coming back, ends up pushing the length flat ball down to long on or one
the wrong'un coming in from wide of the crease, he defends off the back foot
first flighted delivery from Bishnoi, wide too, and he crashes that straight to cover with a booming drive. A deflection gets him a single

this is unbelievable work from Dhruv Jurel! Green comes down to take on Bishnoi who replies by bowling that down leg. Green doesn't connect, he's caught well outside the crease and Jurel goes a mile down the leg side to collect and then reverse flicks it with his right glove for a throw at the stumps while lying almost flat on the ground. Green knew he was gone and started walking immediately but the umpires checked it to be sure
coming in from wide of the crease, flat again, and Green defends on the back foot this time
goes hard on the off side, gets a thick edge and that races away for four through the slip region. Quick and flat again and the pace worked in Green's favour
starts flat and short at 101.8kmh on the stumps, punched down to long on for one
pulls the short of length ball again, this time he doesn't quite get the distance but with the fielders inside the circle he still gets two
here's the first six of the chase and the Kolkata crowd loves it! Green heaves again and this time he connects to dispatch the ball over midwicket
heaves across the line off the back foot but misses that completely as the ball is angled across him
142.8kmh, pushed on the back foot again, he gets a single down to mid off
hangs back and tries to punch that away but finds extra cover
tight line and length aimed for off stump, he defends off the back foot for one
tries to test him with bounce off the short delivery, Raghuvanshi defends on the back foot
back of length and he punches it away for one into the covers
outside off again, a tad shorter and this time he pushes towards cover
beaten all ends through! Ripping delivery on length on off at 143.8kmh, scrambled seam which makes the ball seam away and Green nearly edges it behind
into the body, it's not a bad ball at all, but Green uses the pace of the ball and works that with the movement down the leg side for another boundary. The crowd loves it!
testing line just outside off with a hint of movement, he helps it down to deep third
fuller length so he goes down on a knee this time to get to the pitch of the ball and caresses that all along the ground. Four more
140.4kmh, Green goes on his toes this time to get on top of the short ball and he scythes that away square of the wicket for four. That'll settle some nerves
inside edge not far from the stumps! Short and angling across, Raghuvanshi hops to keep it down and could have chopped on another day, but gets one on the leg side
147.8kmh, how's that for pace. Length ball headed for the stumps, Green pokes at it tentatively because of the angle and he gets a thick outside edge to off and he's off the mark
another duck for Rahane! It's outside off, Rahane goes after it with hard hands and only manages a thick outside edge for a regulation catch straight into Jurel's safe gloves
around good length on middle and leg, clipped to midwicket
141.3kmh, he waits on the back foot for any late movement and maneuvers that beautifully with a steer square of the pitch and right in the gap for four. What timing
bangs it in short again but this one's down leg for a wide
140.1kmh, back of length outside off and he punches that into the covers
Archer on fire! Here's a bouncer now that goes over Raghuvanshi's pull and there's half an appeal for a catch but there's nothing there
beaten! Pace on again and he straightens it off the pitch outside off, Raghuvanshi pokes and misses
full and wide, he jams in into the ground before Jadeja catches it at point and does a mock celebration to tease the crowd

gone first ball! Jofra Archer is the man who rattles Seifert's stumps with one that's full, seams in and goes through the bat and pad gap to deflect off the pad and onto the stumps. What a cracking start for RR
